knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r load libraries}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r T1 QC rating distributions}

# --- 1) Read & clean ---
qc <- read_excel("/Users/bsevchik/projects/QC_docs/T1_QC_pass_fail.xlsx", skip=1) |> 
  clean_names()


# Normalize labels and ensure numeric AVG
qc_clean <- qc |>
  mutate(
    pass_fail = str_to_lower(as.character(pass_fail)),
    pass_fail = case_when(
      str_detect(pass_fail, "pass") ~ "pass",
      str_detect(pass_fail, "fail") ~ "fail",
      str_detect(pass_fail, "artifact") ~ "artifact",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    avg = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(avg))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(avg), !is.na(pass_fail))

# --- 2) Quick check of counts (optional) ---
table(qc_clean$pass_fail)

# --- 3) Histogram of AVG ratings (0–1), colored by status ---
p <- ggplot(qc_clean, aes(x = avg, fill = pass_fail)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0, closed = "left", alpha = 0.85, color = "white") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Average T1 QC Ratings",
    x = "Average rating (0–1)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "QC status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

print(p)

# Save 
ggsave("/Users/bsevchik/projects/QC_docs/T1_QC_avg_histogram.png", p, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

```


```{r fMRI distribution}
# --- 1) Read & clean ---
header_skip <- 0  # can change if needed

qc_fMRI <- read_csv(
  "/Users/bsevchik/Documents/GitHub/transdiagnostic_executive_function/QC/qc_csvs/final_QC_csvs/EF_desc-fMRI_qc.csv",
  skip = header_skip,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

qc_clean_fMRI <- qc_fMRI %>%
  mutate(
    # normalize & sanitize the label
    pass_fail = str_trim(str_to_lower(as.character(qc_determination))),
    pass_fail = case_when(
      str_detect(pass_fail, "^pass$") ~ "pass",
      str_detect(pass_fail, "^fail$") ~ "fail",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  # keep rows where qc_determination is present and recognizable
  filter(!is.na(qc_determination), !is.na(pass_fail))

# --- 2) Counts of 'pass' and 'fail' in qc_determination ---
pass_fail_counts <- qc_clean_fMRI %>%
  count(pass_fail, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

print(pass_fail_counts)

# --- 3) Number of PARTICIPANTS with at least one 'pass' ---
participants_with_any_pass <- qc_clean_fMRI %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  summarize(any_pass = any(pass_fail == "pass", na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

n_participants_with_pass <- sum(participants_with_any_pass$any_pass)
total_participants <- nrow(participants_with_any_pass)

cat(
  sprintf(
    "Participants with at least one pass: %d out of %d (%.1f%%)\n",
    n_participants_with_pass,
    total_participants,
    100 * n_participants_with_pass / total_participants
  )
)


```
